oracle: Original IQ2 lattice initialization, exact neighbour shell sorting, scalar weighted/unweighted functions and reference wrappers compiled independently into iq2_oracle.dll.
qualifications: IQ2_XXS and IQ2_XS use required explicit importance weights. IQ2_S has both original optional-weight and unweighted paths; the latter uses its source variance-dependent weights.
All weights are explicit when weighted. No importance weights are fabricated for the unweighted entry point. Zero-weight rows preserve source search/tie behavior.
